title: Summer Social 2027
content: Summer Social 2027 by Gayshini | Nov 3, 2026 Summer Social 2027 Invite-only networking event Date July 2027 – TBC Location Cambridge, UK Day(s) : Hour(s) : Minute(s) : Second(s) ELRIG’s Summer Social is dedicated to celebrating our incredible community of volunteers. This is our way of expressing gratitude to the dedicated individuals who contribute in various roles, from our board directors to red shirt volunteers to workgroup participants, and more. This year we’re also giving our community an exclusive insight to our 2028 events calendar at this event.
